description: Fetch one track by its SonoVault track ID, with full metadata (ISRC, genre, duration, BPM, musical key, artist credits, releases). Tempo and key: bpm (full tempo, e.g. 123) and musical key in three notations: key_alphanumeric (e.g. '10B'), key_musical (e.g. 'D', 'F#m') and key_open (Open Key, e.g. '3d'), plus keys[] with one entry per source. All null (keys empty) when the track has not been analysed.
name: get_track
title: Get track by ID
